comment: The AI equity section refers generally to representative data but does not identify age as a material dimension. Older people are often under-represented in datasets and may differ in multimorbidity, medication patterns, physiology, disability, communication and care setting. Aggregate performance can therefore conceal age-related error or exclusion.

public.text: The AI equity section refers generally to representative data but does not identify age as a material dimension. Older people are often under-represented in datasets and may differ in multimorbidity, medication patterns, physiology, disability, communication and care setting. Aggregate performance can therefore conceal age-related error or exclusion.
public.suggestedRevision: Add: “AI evaluation datasets and performance reporting should be examined across age groups, disability and functional-access needs, sex, language and care setting, including community and long-term-care settings. Countries should test for age-related under-performance, inaccessible interaction and automation that inappropriately substitutes for human support or informed decision-making.”
